# Market Claim Verifier

> Paste a finance post. Every number is checked against SEC filings, and you get a corrected draft with citations.

Paste → Muse finds SEC evidence → Python decides + corrected draft. The model proposes; the program decides. Meta Muse Spark chooses SEC tools; Python calculates, validates periods, units, citations and evidence IDs, and determines supported / contradicted / insufficient evidence.

## Start here

- [Live check](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/#live-check): password-protected; saved examples need none. Judges: password in the submission notes. Website input: pasted text ≤600 characters. CLI: text, screenshots (Muse OCR), PDFs with text, audio/video (Muse Voice Transcribe).
- [Saved Apple check](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/#recorded-run): frozen evidence and model trace, no password. Saved examples are recorded runs, not fresh execution.
- [Evidence index](docs/evidence/INDEX.md) · [Explorer](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/explorer/) · [In the wild](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/wild/) · [CLI and technical reference](docs/evidence/TECHNICAL_GUIDE.md).

- [Facts](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/#facts) · [Judge guide](JUDGES.md) · [Traditional Chinese](https://hackathon.dappgo.com/zh/).

## Headline claims and proof

- [Original held-out text benchmark](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT.md#metrics): **90.2% (240/266)**, **false support 1/139** reference contradicted/insufficient claims, Baseten Muse Spark Open. Corrected gold (two changes); failures count as wrong. [Registered-gold scores](docs/evidence/eval-v2-2026-10-27/REPORT-registered-gold.md) remain available. The manifest records a dirty working tree.
- [Production check, 2026-11-03](docs/evidence/live-prod-2026-11-03/REPORT.md): deployed; wrong password → unauthorized; Apple revenue → supported; `meta-models/muse-spark-open-1026` on Baseten; $0.01 per live check, 6–20 s live (one claim → four-assertion post); current live budget $10/day and $60 lifetime. Owner-supplied production verification; no new paid call for the IA update.
- Price: $0.01 per live check; $0.02 per claim in the benchmark. Speed: 6–20 s live (one claim → four-assertion post); 10 s median in the benchmark. Recorded observations, not service guarantees.
- US-GAAP SEC filers: ≈8,000 companies; 23 tested. SEC XBRL periods generally 2009 onward through the latest filing. [Facts in detail](docs/evidence/REVIEW_GUIDE.md#facts-in-detail). Saved demonstrations remain frozen.
- Corrected drafts strike disproved numbers, insert filed values and cite the filing. Only checked assertions change; never labelled "approved". Saved traces preserve only the output actually recorded.

## Limits and retained records

Extraction can miss assertions. Benchmark text is not a guarantee on every post. Real-world coverage ≠ accuracy; [post-hoc rechecks](docs/evidence/real-world-2026-11-03-fixcheck/REPORT.md) use previously seen inputs and do not retest OCR/ASR. Historical all-claim scores, corrected gold, partial/failed attempts and media boundaries remain on the [evidence pages](docs/evidence/REVIEW_GUIDE.md#limits). Empty single-shot rerun rows are not results. Source tagging, restatements, fiscal periods, unverified speakers and sampled frames limit evidence. Browser file uploads remain planned.

[Offline verification](AGENTS.md): `bash scripts/verify.sh`; use `UV_OFFLINE=1` after locked dependencies are cached. No model calls or SEC fetches. DappGo existed before; the verifier, site and evidence were built during the hackathon from 27 Oct 2026. [MIT](LICENSE) · [Credits](CREDITS.md) · [Test-record policy](docs/TEST_RECORDS.md).
